name: Andre Macapinlac
title: Founder
bio: I'm Andre Macapinlac, founder of Charitize and a software engineering student. I created Charitize to bridge modern web technology with grassroots philanthropy, ensuring that community assistance is delivered directly, transparently, and effectively. From designing the web interface and secure Stripe payment workflows to organizing local outreach drives, my focus is on providing reliable support to families in need.
